How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate posts is 03 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Senior Project Associate position at CSIR NEERI. These positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include B.E./B.Tech with 3 years of experience, M.Sc. with 3 years of experience, or M.E./M.Tech with 2 years of experience in relevant engineering or science disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Project Associate post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Project Associate posts will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the CSIR NEERI Senior Project Associate recruitment must be submitted in online mode only. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI) is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the positions are contractual. This recruitment is for contractual roles, offering an opportunity for candidates to gain experience in a government research institute.
